name: Chatbot
description: Map of NHS in Wales. An NLP-driven conversational assistant built with Streamlit and Sentence Transformers. Uses vector embeddings and cosine similarity to perform semantic searches over organizational datasets.

paragraphs: An intelligent, NLP-driven conversational agent designed to dynamically query structured organizational data. Originally built to map the NHS Wales organizational hierarchy, this tool uses Vector Embeddings to understand the semantic meaning behind user questions, rather than relying on brittle keyword matching.
features: Semantic Search: Utilizes advanced NLP to match user queries with dataset columns based on contextual meaning, not just exact text matches.
High-Speed Inference: Pre-computes and caches dataset embeddings (.pkl), ensuring rapid real-time responses during user interaction.
Confidence Thresholding: Implements a strict cosine similarity threshold (0.60) to prevent hallucinated answers, automatically triggering a fallback response if no reliable match is found.
Interactive Web UI: Features a clean, user-friendly interface built with Streamlit for seamless human-computer interaction.
